summary: Chhoto URL is a lightweight link shortening tool designed to convert long web addresses into concise, manageable links. It is distributed as a Docker container and focuses on speed without unnecessary features. As a minimalist project, it serves basic redirection needs efficiently.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a fast, low-resource link shortener without the overhead of heavy enterprise frameworks.
watchOut: It is a minimalist fork with limited advanced features compared to more established redirection platforms, meaning you may miss complex analytics or user management out of the box.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker and is built in Rust, deployment typically involves setting up a container, mounting persistent storage if link data needs to be saved, and placing it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
